name: Physics Settings Enhancer
description: Adds Physics Settings group select-all, reopen retention and preview GIF recording with a plugin-owned control strip and export dialog.

permissions.reason: Register GIF recording, pause, stop, and discard actions with configurable shortcuts.
Atomically enables or disables Physics Settings groups through the verified Editor transaction path.
Checks the remembered GIF export directory and the exported file size.
Writes the recording, its temporary encoder output and the GIF the user exports.
Reads the focused preview surface so the GIF recording strip can follow it and capture frames.
Runs the user-supplied Gifsicle executable to optimize an exported GIF to the requested size.
